questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has base 10cm and height 6cm. What is its area?
questions.why: Triangle area is half of base times height: 0.5 × 10 × 6 = 30 cm². Forgetting to halve gives 60 cm², which is the rectangle area instead.

questions.subject: English
questions.why: Shakespeare was born in Stratford-upon-Avon in 1564. Verona is the setting of Romeo and Juliet, not his birthplace, and London is where he later worked, not where he was born.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: What is the male sex cell called in animal reproduction?
questions.why: The male sex cell is the sperm; the egg is the female sex cell. A zygote is what forms after they combine, not a sex cell itself.

questions.subject: History
questions.prompt: In what year did the First Crusade begin?
questions.why: The First Crusade began in 1096. 1066 is the Norman Conquest, and the other dates belong to unrelated medieval events.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: What is the volume of a cube with side length 4cm?
questions.why: Cube volume is side cubed: 4 × 4 × 4 = 64 cm³. Multiplying only two sides gives the area of one face, not the volume.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A shape is a 10cm by 4cm rectangle with a 2cm by 4cm rectangle removed. What is the remaining area?
questions.why: The whole rectangle is 40 cm², minus the removed 8 cm² piece, leaving 32 cm². Forgetting to subtract gives the wrong total of 40 cm².

questions.subject: Geography
questions.prompt: What term describes countries becoming more linked through trade and technology?
questions.why: Globalisation is the growing connection between countries through trade, technology, and culture. Urbanisation instead refers to city growth.

questions.subject: History
questions.prompt: What was Jerusalem's religious importance to Christians, Muslims, and Jews during the Crusades?
questions.why: Jerusalem held deep religious significance to all three faiths, which is exactly why control of the city was so fiercely contested during the Crusades.

questions.subject: English
questions.prompt: Which acting company did Shakespeare belong to?
questions.why: Shakespeare was a member of the Lord Chamberlain's Men. The Royal Shakespeare Company is a modern theatre group, not his original one.

questions.subject: English
questions.prompt: What effect does the Chorus's prologue create at the start of Romeo and Juliet?
questions.why: The prologue tells the audience the lovers will die, creating dramatic irony as we watch events unfold knowing the outcome.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: What is pollination in flowering plants?
questions.answer: Transfer of pollen to a stigma
questions.why: Pollination is simply the transfer of pollen to a stigma, which then allows fertilisation to occur. It is a separate step from fertilisation itself.
